task: Enable audited public URL retrieval through the managed Cloudflare Workers egress boundary.
nonGoals: Frontend changes, changes to any existing Cloudflare service, paid services, full rubric coverage, or explicit application IP pinning

outcomes.description: Only validated public HTTP and HTTPS hostnames are accepted; redirects and robots retrieval reuse destination validation, bound requests and carry no caller credentials.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen rejection, credential and redirect scenarios

outcomes.description: Evaluate the documented Cloudflare network boundary and verify a real product audit in a dedicated zone-free Worker without private network bindings.
outcomes.evidence: Primary Cloudflare sources, hosted checks and live isolated audit

process.description: Keep new resources isolated and require independent security review and hosted CI.
process.evidence: Git history, resource scope and review

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse the existing bounded retrieval, status, storage and rubric paths.

exitTest.reason: This retrieval transport does not change portability, workflow, handoff or resumability.
